metadata.title: Cookie policy | CostaSpanish Academy
metadata.description: Information about the use of cookies on this website.

title: Cookie policy
intro: This website uses cookies and other technologies to ensure proper operation and, with consent, analyse user navigation.

what.title: What are cookies?
what.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device when visiting a website.

types.title: Types of cookies
types.p1: Technical cookies: necessary for the basic operation of the website.
types.p2: Analytics technologies: allow aggregated analysis of user behaviour and may operate with or without cookies.

used.title: Cookies and technologies used on this website

cookieConsent.label: cookie_consent — Necessary
cookieConsent.value: Stores the user's consent preferences. Approximate duration: 1 year.

ga.label: _ga — Analytics
ga.value: Provider: Google Analytics / Google LLC. Distinguishes browsers or users for analytics measurement. Duration: up to 2 years, depending on configuration and browser.

gaProperty.label: _ga_30QRZM80ER — Analytics
gaProperty.value: Provider: Google Analytics / Google LLC. Maintains session information and state for CostaSpanish's GA4 property. Duration: up to 2 years, depending on configuration and browser.

vercelAnalytics.label: Vercel Web Analytics
vercelAnalytics.value: A first-party, cookieless measurement technology. By CostaSpanish's choice, it loads only after analytics consent is granted.

googleAnalytics.label: Google Analytics 4
googleAnalytics.value: An analytics measurement service that loads only after Analytics consent is granted and may create the _ga and _ga_30QRZM80ER cookies.

tagManager.label: Google Tag Manager
tagManager.value: A tag manager that loads and configures Google Analytics 4 after Analytics consent is granted. It is not a separate analytics provider.

manage.title: Cookie management
manage.p1: The "Analytics" category in the banner controls both Vercel Web Analytics and Google Analytics 4. Users can accept, reject or configure it through the cookie banner.
manage.p2: Consent can be modified at any time using the cookie settings link in the footer.

update.title: Cookie policy updates
update.p1: This policy may be updated to reflect legal or technical changes.
